beats.caption: One line, the chapter title
beats.narration: One idea, spoken. About 60 words is 25 seconds. Spell out what must not be misread - 'dot css', 'src slash styles' - and never read code aloud.

beats.caption: The claim of the beat
beats.narration: Scene types: figure (a generated diagram), cards (three claims), terminal (a captured transcript), ide (a file typed on screen), ide-split (a change beside its effect), preview (a live page, such as Storybook).

beats.caption: The file, typed
beats.narration: Lines are revealed left to right; the pace is the beat duration divided by the character count, so there is nothing to tune.

scene.title: A heading for the scene
lines: /* the literal file contents, one string per line */

beats.caption: The change, and its effect
beats.narration: themeAt is a fraction of the beat: 0.52 flips the pane to dark a little past halfway.

beats.caption: The command, honestly replayed
beats.narration: A log name refers to video/build/logs/<name>.json, written by sandbox.mjs from a real run. Long waits are cut and marked with an ellipsis, never sped up.
